Server-Side TLS

Provides TLS server context creation (certificate/key loading, ALPN), async SSL_accept handshake, and AsyncStream vtable for server connections.

IMPORTANT: All SSL operations (SSL_accept, SSL_read, SSL_write) must run on the reactor thread. In MT mode, if called from a worker thread, the initial call is proxied to the event loop via postToEventLoop.

Expose the native SSL_CTX_ctrl binding used by the TLS transport.

Types

TlsServerContext = ref object
  sslCtx*: SslCtx
  alpnProtocols*: seq[string]
  alpnWire*: seq[byte]       ## Wire-format of server preferred protocols
TlsServerStream = ref object of AsyncStream
  tcpStream*: TcpStream
  alpnProto*: string         ## Negotiated ALPN protocol
